prompt: Our seaside town is getting (busy) and (busy) this summer.
explanation_ru: Постепенное усиление признака у коротких прилагательных передаётся повтором сравнительной степени через and: busier and busier.

prompt: The (clear) the map is, the (few / mistake) drivers make.
explanation_ru: В конструкции the…, the… обе части стоят в сравнительной степени; с исчисляемым существительным mistakes используется fewer.

prompt: Cars drive (fast) and (fast) down our street after dark.
explanation_ru: Нарастание скорости действия выражается повтором сравнительного наречия faster and faster.

prompt: The (hard) Lucia trains, the (well) she swims in races.
explanation_ru: Взаимосвязь усилия и результата строится по схеме the + сравнительная степень…, the + сравнительная степень: harder и неправильная форма better от well.

prompt: Isn't rent getting more and (expensive) here while our neighbours have less and (little / space) for the same price?
explanation_ru: С длинным прилагательным expensive повторяют слово more (more and more expensive), а с неисчисляемым space — less and less space.

prompt: Don't rush the shelf brackets, because the (carefully) I measure them, the (little / trouble) I have hanging the cupboard.
explanation_ru: Длинное наречие carefully образует сравнительную степень через more, а с неисчисляемым существительным trouble используется less.

prompt: On that mountain trail, the (high) visitors climb, the (narrow) the path becomes along the cliff.
explanation_ru: Обе части причинно-следственной конструкции the…, the… требуют сравнительной степени: higher и narrower (также допустимо more narrow).

prompt: "Are cheap ferry tickets getting more and (difficult) to find?" "Yes, there are fewer and (few / cabin) left for July."
explanation_ru: У длинного прилагательного difficult повторяем more (more and more difficult), а для уменьшающегося числа кают — fewer and fewer cabins.

prompt: Without enough trained drivers in the region, the (small) the pool of applicants gets, the (serious) every hiring decision becomes for the bus company.
explanation_ru: Связь двух изменений передаётся конструкцией the smaller…, the more serious…, где короткое прилагательное получает -er, а длинное — more.

prompt: Once the energy bills were published, the (strong) the proof looked, the (weak) the landlord's excuse sounded to the angry tenants.
explanation_ru: Два параллельных изменения выражаются через the stronger…, the weaker…; после глаголов looked и sounded стоят прилагательные.

prompt: Pawel showed our warehouse team a simpler way to pack fragile boxes. At first, nobody felt confident with the new steps. However, the (often) we practised, the (smoothly) the morning shift ran. After a week, the work felt (easy) and (easy), and we finished before lunch.
explanation_ru: Наречия often и smoothly в конструкции the…, the… требуют more, а постепенное упрощение задачи передаётся формой easier and easier.

prompt: Honestly, signing up for the community pool used to take two minutes. This term, the desk staff added new forms and ID checks. The whole process is getting more and (complicated) instead of simpler. The (long) the form gets, the (loudly) swimmers complain in the queue. I don't blame anyone for going to the river instead.
explanation_ru: С длинным прилагательным complicated используется more and more complicated; в конструкции the longer…, the more loudly… вторая часть описывает глагол complain.

prompt: Residents complained all winter that nobody explained why the park gate closed early. In spring, the council finally began posting weekly notes online. The (openly) the committee shared its budget, the (calm) the public meetings became. Soon, more and (many / neighbour) joined the clean-up days instead of arguing online.
explanation_ru: В паре the more openly…, the calmer… наречие описывает действие shared, а прилагательное — глагол became; рост числа участников передаётся через more and more neighbours.

prompt: Before selling our new folding bike, we tested fifty frames on rough roads. The (thoroughly) our mechanics checked each joint, the (reliable) the finished bikes proved in heavy rain. Testing took extra days in the workshop, yet riders noticed the difference quickly. Over the season, our reviews got (good) and (good), and repair requests almost disappeared.
explanation_ru: Thoroughly и reliable принимают форму с more в конструкции the…, the…, а постепенное улучшение отзывов передаётся неправильной формой better and better.

prompt: Chidi noticed how tense the junior runners looked before their first relay. He organised short practice handovers in the park instead of long lectures. The (closely) the four teenagers worked together, the (calm) they felt at the starting line. Isn't it true that the (early) a team builds trust, the (confidently) each runner finishes the final lap?
explanation_ru: В обеих конструкциях the…, the… глаголы требуют сравнительных наречий (more closely, earlier, more confidently), а после felt стоит прилагательное calmer.

prompt: Mei's maths homework is getting ___ this term.
explanation_ru: Односложное прилагательное hard образует повтор через -er and -er (harder and harder); вариант more and more hard — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Thick rubber phone cases are becoming ___ with cyclists.
explanation_ru: С многосложным прилагательным popular повторяется только слово more: more and more popular; нельзя опускать второе more или добавлять суффикс -er.

prompt: Karim realised that the more specific a job skill is, ___ open posts there are in small towns.
explanation_ru: Во второй части конструкции the…, the… обязательно нужен артикль the, а с исчисляемым posts ставится fewer, а не less и не двойное more fewer.

prompt: We didn't expect the bakery queue to stretch round the block, yet the longer customers waited in the cold rain, ___ they ordered once they reached the counter.
explanation_ru: Во второй части парного сравнения нужен артикль the и сравнительная форма more (the more pastries); пропуск the и превосходная степень the most — частые ошибки.

prompt: Oksana says the sooner we start revision, sooner we finish.
answer: Oksana says the sooner we start revision, the sooner we finish.
accepted_answers: Oksana says the sooner we start revision, the sooner we finish.
explanation_ru: В парной конструкции the…, the… артикль the обязателен перед обеими частями; его пропуск во второй части — частая ошибка русскоговорящих.

prompt: Declan's homemade brown bread tastes more and more better each time he bakes a fresh loaf.
answer: Declan's homemade brown bread tastes better and better each time he bakes a fresh loaf.
accepted_answers: Declan's homemade brown bread tastes better and better each time he bakes a fresh loaf.
explanation_ru: Неправильная сравнительная форма better не сочетается с more and more; постепенное улучшение передаётся выражением better and better.

prompt: Although searching the old town archive takes patience, the more carefully students check the index cards, the fewer dead ends they hit.
answer: Although searching the old town archive takes patience, the more carefully students check the index cards, the fewer dead ends they hit.
accepted_answers: Although searching the old town archive takes patience, the more carefully students check the index cards, the fewer dead ends they hit.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: обе части конструкции the more carefully…, the fewer… оформлены с артиклем the, а fewer верно стоит перед исчисляемым существительным.

prompt: Mia rewrote her travel blog post with shorter paragraphs and clear headings. After that change, readers stayed on the page much longer.
options: The shorter her paragraphs became, the less time readers spent on the page.
The clearer her post became, the longer readers stayed on the page.
The longer readers stayed on the page, the more confusing her post became.
Her travel blog post became less and less clear as more readers visited it.
explanation_ru: Только второй вариант точно передаёт причину и следствие из текста: чем понятнее стал пост, тем дольше читатели оставались на странице.

prompt: Whenever we pack less luggage, we move faster between platforms. → The less luggage we pack, …
answer: The less luggage we pack, the faster we move between platforms.
accepted_answers: The less luggage we pack, the faster we move between platforms.
explanation_ru: Причинно-следственную связь с whenever перефразируем парным сравнением: во второй части выносим the faster вперёд перед подлежащим и глаголом.
